description: Count how often a word or phrase comes up on a company's last earnings calls, oldest first: mentions per call, the rate per 10,000 words, the split between prepared remarks and Q&A where the call states its hand-off to questions, and one or two short quotes. Whole-word and case-insensitive, so "AI" never matches "said". A call with no transcript text, or one in Chinese, Japanese or Korean, is flagged, never zero. Use it to follow a product, risk or initiative across quarters.

calls.description: Number of most recent earnings calls to read (default 8, max 12; values outside 1-12 are clamped)

phrase.description: Word or phrase to count, 2-80 characters after trimming (e.g. "tariffs", "sovereign AI"). Matched as whole words, ignoring case; a space matches any whitespace.

ticker.description: Company ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, MSFT), or MIC:TICKER (e.g., XPAR:AIR) for a listing outside the US.

name: GetTranscriptPhraseTrend
title: Transcript Phrase Trend
